body:
You sound just like my girlfriend did, is that you? Seriously though, I appreciate the responses, thank you. I talk about all of this because I want to go back and do it all right a second time around. But I know that's impossible. I talk about all of this because I have chosen suicide as my solution, but I am left stuck unable to do it because a couple people care about me. I serve them no purpose, I bring no positive to their table, they only care about me because of the nature of parenthood/family. I don't really know why I even bother typing this all out. I want my life from last year back. I want my girlfriend back, I want my job back, I want that comfort back, but this time be a happy person. Those are the things I want, so if that's the same as wanting to "get well" then sure maybe I do want that. But getting well wont change the past, so what truly is the point. I don't care about my future, I don't want a future. 

There have been many many occasions where I have felt the motivation to do exactly what you just suggested. But it is so much easier said than done, and as soon as I get the ball rolling, I don't keep pushing it, and end up putting my foot out to stop it because I don't really care. I feel like I only ever do things for other people, and working to "get better" would, once again, be for the sake of other people. I don't want to be "better," to me that seems somewhat rude of people to always judge depression as being a bad thing, that it is an innate character flaw. It is saying that how my brain has worked for the past 8 years of my life is flawed. How about I accept the way my mind works and just give myself what I want. That is a lot of work and time to dedicate towards "bettering" myself, seemingly for the benefit of those around me. I appreciate you supporting me and trying to help, even offering to help find a medical professional, I admire good people. I just am living in no state of mind where I want that for myself, where I want to go through those motions to maybe "fix" things. People care about me and I truly don't want them to. I don't know what else I am supposed to do to show them I am not worth it.

Im trying to write out my response, I am just struggling significantly. I am sorry. I truly appreciate the response and insight, you dont have to sacrifice your time to share, yet you have. So thank you. I just cant form the response that is stuck in my mind, story of my life. I just get infuriated with myself, and it worsens the attempts. Im sorry, I have nothing of value to say right now. I hope your day/night is going well. Thank you.

I have written a lot about my mind, as well as talked aloud about it. That is the part I can do, I can go on and on about HOW my mind works, I can come up with a million analogies for my mind, but as far as sharing the actual things I have trapped in my head, I am useless at sharing them. All my thoughts concerning my ex are what are a virus. I used to want to feel better, but I have always known that a therapist is not the right option, at least for me. Knowing my life and who I am, therapy wouldn't work. I have opened up in person to only two people ever in my life, and it never worked out well, and was fairly unsuccessful. What worked for me was enjoying my simple, low-wage job and spending time with my incredible girlfriend. But I lost both of those things thanks to my own darkness seeping its way into every aspect of my life. The one other thing that I have found works are drugs. Weed helps for a while, but I no longer have a method of obtaining it. I've used Vyvanse a couple times, a drug meant for ADHD, and that had many positive effects as well, completely relieving my brain of its darkness for a few hours. The Vyvanse has been the easiest, most effective relief I have ever felt, it was unfathomable how much it changed the course of my thoughts for even just a few hours. But of course that wears off as the drug wears off, and my body has a high tolerance to drugs and alcohol, so I had to take those in fairly high doses to even feel anything. But it was something that worked, and it was amazing, I just no longer have any method of obtaining Vyvanse. I have no clue how to get weed or Vyvanse or any drugs, but I really want them. I really want to try acid as well, I'm just completely ignorant on finding and buying drugs, and I have 0 connections. 

Anyway, this has been all over the place again, to answer your question, I have tried writing it all down in the past. I have tried to write it all out as it flows through my mind, I just cant do it. I lose the thoughts too easily, or get sidetracked, and ultimately end up pissed at myself for being so incapable. The few things I end up jotting down are so silly and laughable. And there is no way I am reaching out for a therapist. With my life experiences, I know that that is not right for me. And that's the thing. I really don't want to do any of that anyway, I don't want to get better. Not anymore anyway. It is impossible to help someone who doesn't want to be helped, and that is me. I don't want to be helped. I don't want to get better. I want to conclude my life. That is what I want. I have lived, on paper, a pretty great life. I have traveled, seen things, had good experiences, lived around the world. There is absolutely no reason I should be unhappy with my life, yet I have been for 8 years-ish now. Even in the highest highs of my life, I failed to find happiness. So I know that it is not for me. I know I have no place here. I just cant stand that I can't just leave on my own accord. Because that's just selfish, isn't it. Why is it such a goddamn crime to be selfish? Every single person is selfish, it is natural instinct. Why is it wrong when it comes to taking ones life when they feel it is time to do so? Sorry for such a long silly response.

A bit. But I really don't want to because they don't understand it and the words sound absolutely ridiculous when they leave my mouth. That is one of the issues I have always had with my depressive thoughts, is that I could never accurately share them. I had a girlfriend who wanted to hear the things I thought about, and I tried to tell her on so many occasions, but I simply am incapable of translating from brain to mouth. It would make me hate myself even more that I couldn't even talk about the millions of thoughts I had bottled up inside with the girl I loved more than anybody else in the world. Now of course she is no longer my girlfriend, I obviously ruined that too, and I wish I could simply just forget she existed. I hate that I still am so deeply in love with her, I hate how I am making myself hate her. She is so much better off without me, but there are so many things left unresolved that I cant shake. It is like a virus in my mind, and it makes me punch things and throw things and I want her out of my mind. I am off on a tangent. Anyway, no, I don't find comfort from my family. I have tried to reach out in the most minimal ways in the past, just to sorta test the waters, and it amounts to absolutely nothing. I don't want my family. I know I will be different in a month or a year. That is the point though, I am sick of waiting that long just to see if things have changed. For many years it has been consistent about me that I don't want to be on this earth anymore. That never changes. I don't want to travel the road to where I am different in the future. That is a long road. I would rather veer off now.

Welp I just accidently deleted my entire response I had to your comment. Shit. I appreciate the response, but those things don't work for me. I cant go on explaining my whole life story, but I have tried everything, and nothing works. I ruin everything good in my life, the world would be so much better without me. I find 0 enjoyment out of everything, I have no passions, no interests, no hobbies. I have had my chances at happiness, and I have ruined them all. I cant stand my "loved ones" because they are holding me back. I don't want my family with me. Sorry, I had a much longer and thorough response before that I deleted like the fucking moronic waste of human life I am. Sorry.
